modalities.evidence: MRI data were analyzed in FreeSurfer

output.population: Public deidentified MRI and PET data were obtained from openneuro.org for 16 subjects who underwent a [11C]PS13 PET scan; healthy controls
output.summary: A Molecular Imaging Brain Atlas of cyclooxygenase-1 built from public deidentified MRI and PET data. Distribution volumes were quantified with PETsurfer and averaged across subjects into ROI tables and voxel-wise maps on standard brain templates.
